title: HiringNow
description_en: AI job agent that finds & apply for jobs before anyone else.. HiringNow checks 247,000+ company career sites every 5 minutes, so you see new jobs before they hit the big boards. It matches each job to your profile, tailors your resume and cover letter, and applies on the employer's own site, only with your approval. Every application gets a receipt in your job tracker. Also: resume builder and mock interviews. Free plan with 10 auto-applies.

title: Rakazo
description_en: The open source Grok Bot alternative you actually own. Rakazo gives you AI teammates that keep working after you close the chat. Each bot has its own memory, routines and computer, with a browser you can watch and take over. Open source and self-hosted: any model, your keys, your machine. Web, desktop and mobile.

title: Businesses in ChatGPT
description_en: Help customers discover your business through ChatGPT. Discover how customers find your business in ChatGPT. Claim your business profile, manage information, explore insights, and create a Business Agent if eligible

title: Dex Semantics
description_en: Let your agent build analytics with 25% fewer errors. Dex Semantics adds declarations to your analytical models, which capture row meaning, join nature, how numbers add up, and decisional assumptions. Thanks to this, Dex scores 80% on ADE-bench with Claude Sonnet 5.5, compared to 73.3% without Dex (25% fewer tasks failed). Declarations live in your models as code, not a third-party tool. Dex then helps your agent convert declarations into your Semantic Layer of choice.

title: Gemini Robotics 2.5
description_en: Gemini Robotics 2.5: Google’s most capable robot model. Gemini Robotics 2.5 is Google DeepMind’s most capable vision-language-action model, turning what a robot sees and is told into hand and arm movements. Per DeepMind, it has a 30% to 100% higher success rate than the previous baseline, finishes tasks 20% to 30% faster, and reached 96% success in a Mercedes-Benz parts-kitting pilot with Apptronik’s Apollo 2 humanoid. Works across robot types. Rolling out to robotics partners.

title: Frevana Multiplayer
description_en: AI that grows your business alongside your team. Frevana runs AI agent apps that find customers, create content, and automate busywork. Now it's multiplayer: invite your team with a link, share agents and skills, and build on each other's work. Your best workflow becomes everyone's.

title: Tulvo
description_en: Smart & adaptive workspace to manage all your work. Most small businesses run on 10 or more apps that never share data. Docs in one place, tasks in another, customers in a spreadsheet, forms and the website somewhere else. Tulvo puts all of it on one set of connected data. Describe your business in a sentence and Tulvo AI sets up the databases, boards, docs and reports for it. Bring in data from forms and webhooks, automate work, connect your own AI through MCP and host live sites. Try for free for 30 days and grab 50% OFF during Black Friday.

title: Talyn
description_en: Run Claude Code and Codex in parallel cloud sandboxes. Talyn runs Claude Code and Codex in parallel cloud sandboxes, on the plan you already pay for. Close the laptop and come back to a diff, or to a pull request that is already green. Free with 10 box-hours a month. For GitHub, on macOS, Windows, Linux, or the browser.

title: CaptureFlow
description_en: Open-source screen recorder with instant share links. Record your screen with the Chrome extension and share a link with your team or customers. Your AI agents can record too, through the MCP server: demos, how-tos and bug reports.

title: Canvas by AgentGrid.io
description_en: Agentic Design Canvas - A visual way to collaborate with AI. Agentic Canvas by AgentGrid.io is a free, agent-first design tool where humans and AI agents work together on real HTML. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Grok Bot, Muse AI, Instinct, Hermes, Cursor, Codex, or any MCP-compatible agent. Design visually, edit by hand, and let AI pick up where you left off. Free, local, no signup required.

title: Kokonut UI
description_en: Open-source UI components for your AI agent. Kokonut UI is a free, MIT-licensed library of 100+ React components made for coding agents. Connect through MCP in Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code or Codex, ask for "a tool approval card in my chat", and your agent finds the component, installs it and edits it in your repo. Every docs page is also served as Markdown for agents. This release adds 65 components and rebuilds 34, led by AI chat parts: tool calls, tool approval, diff review, citations and more.

title: TwoBucket
description_en: Beginner-friendly mobile detailing software for bookings. TwoBucket is beginner-friendly mobile detailing software for solo detailers and small teams. Customers send their vehicle, its condition and photos from your booking page or website. You send a quote they approve online, then an invoice they pay by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay into your own Stripe or Square account, with deposits and tips. Visits sync to Google Calendar or iCloud. iPhone, Android and web, or ask ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok or Muse. $20/month, 7-day free trial.

title: Uber Parking
description_en: Find, compare and reserve parking inside the Uber app. Uber Parking lets you find, compare and reserve parking right in the Uber app. Unlike circling the block or juggling a separate parking app, you enter a destination and time, see lots and garages on a map with upfront prices, filter by valet, self-park or amenities, and pay with Uber Wallet. Scan a QR code or drive in with plate recognition, extend from your phone if you run late. 13,000+ garages, lots and valets in 400 US and Canadian cities. Uber One members get 10% back.

title: Antelog
description_en: Stops AI coding agents from leaking or destroying your data. AI coding agents are amazing. Until one deletes your database, or leaks your secrets. Antelog stops the disasters before they happen, and shows you everything your AI did: every command, every website, every bit of data it sent. Works with Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Free.

title: Valutorio
description_en: Your Markdown notes, native on Mac and iPhone. Free Mac and iPhone app that opens the Markdown vault you already keep, nothing to import. Wikilinks, backlinks, search, daily notes, a graph on the Mac. Sync ($5.99/mo) keeps Mac and iPhone the same and lets your AI read and write your notes over MCP.

title: MAP & GO!
description_en: See your day on the map. MAP & GO! puts your day on the map: tasks and events land on a place, weather sits on the pin, and AI is one tap away, so you can find a place, look around, and navigate without leaving the app, with Apple and Google connected.

title: Perit Marketplace
description_en: Sell your data and RL tasks to frontier AI labs. Perit Marketplace turns your data and expertise into training work for frontier AI labs. Two ways in: submit data you own (audio, video, code, docs, CAD and more; 29 datasets listed so far), or build RL tasks and benchmarks on our platform using our VMs and model credits. We pitch them to labs, and approved experts scale to hundreds of tasks a week. Built by Perit (YC F26), now past $11M in revenue in 4.5 months.

title: Spiik
description_en: AI note taker for meetings & lectures. No bot on your calls.. Spiik records meetings, lectures, interviews and calls, then gives you a transcript you can trust: it copes with accents and noisy rooms, labels who said what, and translates into 100+ languages. On a Mac it records Zoom, Meet and Teams with no bot joining the call. From there, get structured notes, quizzes and flashcards, or ask the recording a question. iPhone, iPad and Mac.

title: CodeMesh
description_en: Cut AI coding costs by 90%. CodeMesh helps AI coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf understand your code faster. Instead of reading the same files again and again, CodeMesh gives them only the code they need. This can reduce token usage and AI costs by over 90%, while making coding agents faster and more efficient. You keep using your favorite coding tool CodeMesh simply makes it smarter and cheaper.

title: ByteAsk Cloud Agents
description_en: Find the fix in big codebases. Ship it from Slack.. ByteAsk gives Claude Code and Codex an index of your whole repo, so they start in the right file. Its Cloud Agent takes bugs from Slack, Jira or the browser, builds and tests in a sandbox, and opens a draft PR. Start with $50 of credit, no card.

title: ScreenGo
description_en: screen recorder for Mac with auto zooms and virtual webcam. A Mac screen recorder with a camera bubble, teleprompter and an editor that does the polish for you: zooms, cursor, captions and clean sound. No account, nothing leaves your Mac.

title: Pixel Office
description_en: Run a team of AI agents from a pixel-art office. Most agent tools are a chat box. Pixel Office is a place: each employee is a real AI agent (Claude, Codex, Gemini or OpenRouter) with its own role, memory, skills and permission level. See at a glance who is working, who needs your approval and who is done. Hire in a character creator, hand out tasks on a board, let agents message each other, and decorate the office with coins from finished work. Open source, one command, runs on your machine with your own keys.

title: GotEmail
description_en: Fast, native and smart email for Mac and iPhone. GotEmail is a native mail app for Mac and iPhone. Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, Yahoo and any IMAP account in one fast inbox, with a Smart Inbox that sorts out what matters, AI drafts, summaries and an assistant that knows your mail, one-click sign-in codes, snooze, send later, undo send, read receipts, labels and smart folders. No ads, no account of ours: your mail goes straight between your device and your provider. One license covers every Mac and the iPhone app.

title: Privacyboard
description_en: Privacy compliance on autopilot. Enter your website: Privacyboard detects your tools and drafts your privacy policy, cookie banner, records and DPA in minutes. Vendors are watched daily, deadlines tracked, and your AI assistant can fill in the rest. Free plan, data in the EU.

title: Thunder
description_en: A blazing-fast, persistent, key-value AI workload database. Thunder is a blazing-fast, persistent, and scalable key-value database built in Rust for modern, data-intensive applications. Designed from the ground up for high throughput, low latency, and efficient resource utilization, Thunder uses a shard-per-core architecture to scale with CPU cores while minimizing contention. Unlike traditional in-memory databases, Thunder combines the performance of modern NVMe storage with intelligent memory management.

title: FreeFlow Dictation
description_en: On-device Mac dictation with a Claude Code voice hook. Hold ⌥, speak, release: text lands in any Mac app, transcribed on the Neural Engine. No account, no cloud, no telemetry. Connect Claude Code and answer its plans and questions by voice from a card. 14-day trial, then $99 once for 3 Macs.

title: Widgets For Notion
description_en: Free widgets for your Notion page, pasted in with /embed. I made 100+ free widgets you can put on a Notion page. Clocks, calendars, countdowns, timers, habit trackers. Copy the embed link, type /embed in Notion and paste it. No plugin and no account. Need something else? Describe it and AI builds it, using credits.

title: Komrad
description_en: The AI agent that does not work for you. Western agents book your flights and write your emails. Komrad will do none of that. A working AI chat from a fictional Soviet ministry. Free, no login, 10 ration coupons a day. Sound on.

title: The Organized Life
description_en: Bring Your Life Together. Get a starting point for organizing your life in Notion, without having to build every part from a blank page. The Organized Life brings together five systems for your health, finances, travel, productivity and personal growth, and studies. You don’t have to set up everything at once. Start with the area that would help you most right now, add your own details, and build from there.

title: Flyerworks
description_en: World’s first AI marketing & design agent for retail.. Quick commerce moves in minutes, while retail stores lose shoppers waiting days to get an offer designed. Today, days become seconds. Meet Skippi, the world’s first AI agent built exclusively for retail and corner stores. Snap a handwritten price list, paste, or speak it. Skippi turns raw prices into editable flyers and matching shelf tags across 3,000+ designs with zero-hallucination pricing, WhatsApp sharing, and print-ready exports. The corner store is ready to lead again.

title: GEOHATS
description_en: Get your brand recommended by ChatGPT and AI search. GEOHATS is an all-in-one tool that gets your brand recommended in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and Grok by: tracking the questions your buyers ask AI and showing the ones you lose; writing the page built to win each one and publishing it to your site; fixing your site so AI crawlers can read it, in one click; and automated outreach to get mentions on the sites AI trusts. One-time license, your own AI keys.
